batches.requestedOutput: six-pose identity contact sheet for review before animation production
batches.prompt: Create a production concept contact sheet for the PILEUP game asset character.player_child. Hand-drawn 2D/2.5D domestic survival horror style, side-view house diorama game character, transparent background, no text, no watermark, no labels. A small child survivor silhouette, scaled for threats in a cluttered home, wearing muted home-at-night clothing with warm practical-light accents, carrying a flashlight that is clearly readable in every pose. Mood is tense, careful, domestic survival, never superheroic, never cute mobile-cartoon. Include 6 clean isolated poses in a 3x2 grid with consistent character identity: idle with flashlight forward, cautious walk, searching through clutter, hurt/recoiling, aiming flashlight high/deep background, unlocking a door while nervous. Muted cold blue-grey shadows, warm amber highlights, slight desaturation, readable silhouette, strong flashlight direction, no baked room background, no props except flashlight and small carried item silhouette, no checkerboard background.
batches.negativePrompt: photorealistic, superhero, anime mascot, cute mobile cartoon, generic haunted house, fantasy armor, sci-fi gear, adult hero proportions, unreadable flashlight direction, labels, watermark, text, baked background, checkerboard background, halo edges
batches.tool: OpenAI image generation via Codex image_gen, followed by scripts/prepare-contact-sheet.mjs alpha cleanup

batches.requestedOutput: single continuous spooky outside-world bitmap layer masked behind every Level 01 window
batches.prompt: Create a full-quality spooky outside world layer visible only through house windows. The scene should lean on silhouettes, feel deep and parallax-ready, and include moonlit forms that can cast cold light onto an interior floor. Suburban backyard at night seen from inside a family house window, deep layered exterior with distant rooflines, bare tree silhouettes, fence lines, bushes, a narrow path, far houses, heavy night sky, thin clouds, and subtle fog. No interior window frame, no room elements, no text. Empty eerie outside world with readable silhouettes only, not monsters in the foreground. Include depth layers: far moon/sky/clouds, middle houses/fence, near trees and bushes. Hand-drawn 2D/2.5D domestic survival horror game background, painterly but clean enough for runtime use, not photorealistic, not cute cartoon. Ultra-wide landscape scene, continuous complete exterior panorama with no hard panel borders. Keep important silhouette interest spread across the full width so different window crops reveal different parts. Avoid overlap clutter in the center; make it crop-safe for rectangular windows. Cold moonlight, spooky quiet, strong silhouette readability, faint blue-gray haze, small warm distant porch/window lights only as tiny accents. No window frame, no blinds, no interior floor, no interior walls, no characters, no text, no watermark.

batches.requestedOutput: twelve static bedroom prop cutouts for foreground, main-plane, and background parallax placement
batches.prompt: Use the provided PILEUP bedroom foreground prop concept sheet as style and subject reference. Create a clean 4x3 asset sheet of 12 isolated static bedroom props for a 2.5D side-view domestic survival horror game: overflowing laundry basket, dirty clothes mound, child bed corner, nightstand with lamp, toy bin spilling toys, small chair with clothes, battered stuffed plush, scattered books/comics, toy truck and blocks, backpack and shoes pile, tipped cardboard box with mixed clutter, and low dresser with storage crates. Make them creepy and familiar, with subtle unsettling shadow eyes and hidey-holes, but grounded in a real child bedroom. Use hand-drawn painterly 2D/2.5D game prop style, muted blue-gray night palette, worn wood, dirty fabric, low-saturation toy colors, and small warm domestic highlights. Place each object fully visible with padding on a perfectly flat #00ff00 chroma-key background. No labels, no captions, no title, no watermark, no borders, no floor plane, no cast shadows, no humans, no separate monster characters, and no #00ff00 inside the subject.
